{{dablink|For the chapter in ''[[Towers of Midnight]]'' by the same name, see ''[[Towers of Midnight/Chapter 16|Shanna'har]]''}}
'''''Shanna'har''''' is a festival that is held in the early summer in [[Saldaea]] every year to celebrate another year with your husband or wife, another year of neither wife nor husband falling to [[Trollocs]]. Couples are told to savor their first ''shanna'har'' like they would the first taste of a succulent meal. [[Faile]] celebrates ''shanna'har'' with [[Perrin]] but does it in a non-traditional fashion, incorporating a little bit of the [[Two Rivers]] way by taking Perrin out onto a hilltop alone and spending the night with each other.
